text.text_excerpt: I have a fantastic experience at Mezze last night with friends. First, happy hour is 4-7 and well cocktails and draft beer is 1/2 price. To have the best experience I would suggest ordering the small plates and sharing with the group. The individual items were either $5 or $6 which is EXCELLENT for small plate dining. This is great to order enough for a meal or to just have a nice happy hour after work. We had both cold an hot items. Some things that I really enjoyed were... farmer salad, which is chopped up cucumbers, bell peppers tossed with herbs, lemon, and oil. The bowl of this was very large and an excellent pallet cleanser. Stuffed mushrooms (4): wonderful flavor and plenty of feta...

This place is great. They definitely did all the right things in updating this space. It's a new owner from my understanding and he sure knew what this area needed and he delivered. Unlike most New Orleans restaurants it's clean and updated atmosphere with great service. The menu is short but strong. We got the chickpea salad to start with and never in my life did I think a chickpea salad be that flavorful! It had a nice kick to it just as the other food we ordered. We will definitely be back for more great prices on awesome, clearly in-house made Mediterranean food.

I've been here twice and I am happy to report no one else knows about this place. A key observation from both trips - drinks made up 60% of the bill. There is both indoor and outdoor seating. In the right weather, the patio is great. Inside is a comfortable bar environment. It is time to update the TVs. Service has been quick and friendly. The food is excellent. Fresh homemade bread, the salads are large and tasty, high quality traditional Mediterranean foods and all very reasonably priced. Unfortunately, I haven't gotten around to trying any of the Mezzes. We've eaten our way through half the sandwich menu and haven't been disappointed yet. While Mezze isn't trying to be a cocktail bar, ...
